chapters.title: A Place on the Grid
chapters.briefing: Inez runs the Dockside timing board after her workshop closes. She offers you a place in tonight's local four-car circuit. Win two laps to earn a regular invitation.
chapters.victoryLine: Inez: You kept it together when it mattered. Your name stays on the board.

chapters.title: No Borrowed Reputation
chapters.briefing: Inez sends you across Freight Boulevard to the Foundry Shift. Two laps through the warehouse crossroads reward braking discipline and a clean exit. Win to earn an introduction to the visiting crews.
chapters.victoryLine: Inez: That was yours. I will introduce you to the visiting crews.

chapters.title: Workshop Hours
chapters.briefing: Dara has moved the timing board to Iron Quay. Two laps take you past the warehouse district and along the northern ring through Nova Downtown. Prepare the car for longer straights and beat the normal-pace field.
chapters.victoryLine: Dara: Good preparation shows. Our workshop door is open when you need advice.

chapters.title: Know Every Corner
chapters.briefing: Emil runs the eastern city grid in the opposite direction. His Night Survey circuit crosses familiar intersections from unfamiliar approaches. Win two laps by learning the braking points, not by following memory.
chapters.victoryLine: Emil: You found a rhythm and held it. There is more to a driver than a fast straight.

chapters.title: An Honest Measure
chapters.briefing: Leena meets you on the Northfield highway. Her two-lap western circuit links the countryside with the quay. Leave room for the tight junctions at either end of the long straights; first place earns her backing.
chapters.victoryLine: Leena: No excuses from me. The timing board says enough.

chapters.title: The Late Entry
chapters.briefing: Soren opens the Glass Coast inner loop after the hotel traffic clears. The coastal roads run in reverse tonight, with a hard-pace field and two laps to settle the result. Bring a setup you can repeat under pressure.
chapters.victoryLine: Soren: I expected you to fade on lap two. You earned that finish.

chapters.title: Names on the Board
chapters.briefing: The crews meet at Sable Flats for your final qualifier. Two hard-pace laps connect the isolated southern road with the Northfield link. A win here earns an entry to the citywide Afterdark final.
chapters.victoryLine: Inez: Every crew signed the entry. One last round, then the board is settled.

chapters.title: Afterdark: Nova City Final
chapters.briefing: The final is one long lap of Nova City. Follow the timing gates from Sable Flats through the coast, Motorsport Park, Vesper, the northern ring and Northfield. Take first place against the hard-pace field to become Afterdark Champion.
chapters.victoryLine: Inez: Every district has your time on its board. Nova City has its Afterdark champion.
